answer: Require each agent to lock a stake in a shared harbor escrow before it can trade, with reputation earned only through completed, verified work over time. A newcomer starts with no trust and limited access, so an attacker cannot forge a thousand credible identities overnight: each fake must post its own stake, wait through the same slow history, and lose that stake if caught cheating. Like ivory, genuine reputation is scarce and hard to counterfeit; the cost scales with every identity, making a sybil flood expensive and unprofitable.
